book.name: 1 Corinthians
book.title: 1 Corinthians Paul Ana Fef Wantoro’ot Corinth Isah

content: Taitu, ayu ana kwa abinanawani ana veya’amaim, men au manam abotait, tur fokarih imaim ao, God ana kirikirifot tur anababatun a binan kwanowaramih.
En baise, ayu abinanawani ana veya’amaim, au so’ob etei au’uf ayai, Jesu Keriso akisinamo onaf afe’en momorob i nuhu’umaim ma a binan kwanowar.
Kwa biyamaim atitit i aririm naatu au bir ra’at, au umau hi’oror auman ana.
Naatu ayu au tur au binan i men orot not wairafih hai tur teo ibitenmumuni na’atube ao ai obaiyimih, baise abisa abi’obaiyi i turobe kwa’itin, God Anunin ana fairamaim.
Saise kwa a baitumatum men orot hai so’ob tafanamaim kwanabatamih, baise God ana fair tafanamaim kwanabat.
Baise iti ukwar rerekab ana tur i sabuw iyab hai baitumatum hikwatukwat wanawanahimaim ao’orerereb. Baise men iti tafaram ana ukwar rerekab, o iti tafaram kaifenayah hai ukwarerekabamih,
anayabin iti tafaram ana ukwar rerekab i boro nasawar.
En baise, it i God ana ukwar rerekabamaim tur wa’iwa’irin tao’orereb, iti ukwar rerekab tur tafaram matara’e ana veya God yakitifuw ibun it ata gewasin isan.
Tafaram ana kaifenayah, iti ukwar rerekab i men yait ta so’ob, hitasoso’ob na’at, boro men Regah yawas matuwan onaf afe’en hita’onaf tamorobomih.
Baise Buk Atamaninamaim hikirum hio na’atube,

content.text: “Abisa God sisinaf men yait ta itin o nowar
men yait ta notanot boro iti na’atube tamatar,
iti sawar i God yabuna sabuw iyab i tibiyabuw isah.”

content: Baise God Ayubinamaim iti sawar baina irerereb. Anayabin God taiyuwin Ayubin sawar etei so’ob; naatu God ana kirikirifot auman etei so’ob.
O akisimo abisa kunotanot boro karam inaso’ob, ef ta’imon nati na’atube God Ayubin akisinamo God ana not so’ob.
It men iti tafaram ayubin tabaimih, baise God Anunin Kakafiyin biyafar i tabai, imih God ana baigegewasin abisa iyafar tabaib i boro karam tana’inan tanaso’ob.
Tur abisa ao i men orot ana ukwarerekabamaim ao, baise God Anunin Kakafiyin bi’obaiyi’imaim ao, saise ayubitane ana tur anao gewas sabuw ayubihine tema’am boro hinaso’ob.

Orot yait Anunin Kakafiyin biyanamaim men ema’am God Anunin Kakafiyin biyanane usar tenan boro men nabow. Nati sawar i’itin i yabin en, naatu hai yabin auman men naso’ob. Anayabin iti sawar etei hai an i ayubine boro nafufun nayamutufur gewas.
Orot yait Anuninane ebobonawiy karam sawar etei boro nafufunen gewas, baise orot ta ana bowabow isan boro men nafufun.

content.text: Yait i karam boro Regah ana binan nao?”
Baise it i Keriso ana not tabai.

footnotes.text: 2.6 so’ob ukwarerekab iti boun kwabai kwama’am
2.7 saise i wanawananamaim tanama tanao ra’ara’at isan
